A rare deep-sea barreleye fish has been captured in stunning 4K footage by researchers from MBARI, around 600 metres beneath the Pacific Ocean. Its transparent head reveals unusual tubular eyes that can rotate to track prey. From glowing anglerfish to giant-mouthed eels, the deep ocean remains a mysterious world filled with extraordinary creatures. Watch this video for the details fascinating fish and other such wonders of the deep sea.
